in_marathi.name: Bansidhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ban: Shoot, Dhar: Protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bansidhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bansidhar is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: Ban (शूल) which means shoot or arrow, and Dhar (धर्ता) which means protector or sustainer. Thus, Bansidhar means one who protects using a bow and arrow. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is known as the protector of the universe.
